heightM.note: the pool bathhouse's twin towers above the park: the model's top

treeLowM.note: the lower canopy height of the tree masses

treeHighM.note: the upper canopy height (below the bathhouse towers)

treeSpacingM.note: canopy mound spacing at the finest level at density 1

pool.note: the big outdoor pool's centre, placed by eye inside the map's park outline

poolPlan.note: the pool's length (widthM) and width (depthM), the commonly published 330 by 165 ft (drawn at the readability scale)

bathhouse.note: the bathhouse along the pool's east side: length and depth

lawn.note: the great lawn's centre, placed by eye inside the map's park outline

lawnAxes.note: its semi-axes, the long one running north-north-east

track.note: the running track's centre, placed by eye inside the map's park outline

promenadeWidthM.note: the riverside promenade (Shore Boulevard), drawn along the park's west edge

parkHeadingDeg.note: the park's long axis, compass degrees (north-north-east along the river)

readabilityScale.note: The pool, bathhouse and promenade are drawn larger than real in plan so they read; lamps three times a lamp head.

gameScale.note: Game scale (orchestrator decision 2026-10-08, the user may overrule): heights x1.6 (trees, the bathhouse); the plan stays the map's park outline (park-qn0191), structures and paths take the readability scale.
